newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: S.Costa jumps after resuming trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Costa jumps after resuming trade.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese construction firm Soares da Costa jumped 12 percent to 1,750 escudos after resuming trade on Lisbon bourse, dealers said.
The shares were briefly interrupted today after a newspaper report, later denied by Soares da Costa, said builder Teixeira Duarte may have agreed with shareholders to buy stakes in Soares da Costa.
Dealers said the share could surpass 1,750 escudos if speculators continued to bet on a bid for Soares da Costa.
Soares da Costa stood at 1,680 escudos, up 120, in volume of 19,300 shares at 1047 GMT.
